field_edits.updated_text: Left reverse total shoulder arthroplasty is present with chronic osseous remodeling about the proximal humerus surrounding the humeral component, corresponding to the site of the previously reported comminuted periprosthetic fracture. Persistent periprosthetic lucency along the humeral component, including near the distal stem, may reflect chronic loosening. No fracture or focal lesion.
No gross dislocation. The joint spaces and articular margins are normal.

impression:
1. Left reverse total shoulder arthroplasty with chronic osseous remodeling and periprosthetic lucency concerning chronic loosening.
2. No acute osseous abnormality.
